note_corrections.reason: The WWF primate-conservation report distinguishes the two species and their English names, while primary primatological reporting independently lists them as separate species: https://wwfasia.awsassets.panda.org/downloads/primates_of_the_greater_mekong_report__2021___double_page.pdf and https://primate-society.com/ips/public/ips_program/IPS10-175.pdf .
